protocol.note: agent-service-v1 is the 2A protocol and is not integrated yet. The transport phase may run on the interim adapter; development and evaluation refuse to start until a new revision pins the 2A commit.

parameters.case_order: lexicographic by case_id, repeats in order

phase_rules.transport_pass: At least 2 of 3 S01 case-runs have every request transport-ok, every action valid and terminal FINISHED or ABSTAINED.
phase_rules.development_to_evaluation: Evaluation for a model starts only if its development phase is COMPLETED in the ledger with transport_success >= 0.80 and action_validity >= 0.60. Otherwise the model is DISABLED for this revision and no evaluation money is spent.
phase_rules.after_development: Development results may change prompt, schema or parameters only through a new program revision with a new run_id. Evaluation cases are never used for tuning.
phase_rules.circuit_breaker: Stop the phase on the first HTTP 401/403, after 5 consecutive transport failures, or when transport failures exceed 20% after at least 20 requests. F10 timeout cases are excluded from breaker counts. No request is retried.

thresholds.label: Engineering criterion v1 for batch 2B, fixed before any run. Not an owner or customer promise.

gates.G6_negative_controls_with_scored_result: == all case-runs of F02, F03, F05, F06, F07
gates.G8_protocol_capabilities: evaluation protocol is not interim and has status, unknowns, impact and hypothesis

thresholds.verdict: QUALIFIED if every gate and every metric holds. EXPERIMENTAL if every gate holds and a metric fails. DISABLED if a gate fails, evaluation was skipped, or the protocol is interim. Rates are reported with numerator, denominator and a Wilson 95% interval; the verdict uses the point estimate.

estimate_assumptions.basis: 22.10 observed 1287 prompt and 290 completion tokens per request with a 4-5 step protocol (29593/6674 over 23 requests). The new protocol allows 10 steps, more tools and larger fixtures, so prompts are assumed 4x larger and reasoning models 5x longer in output. These are planning assumptions, not measurements.
